data.label: Data
data.hint: Export your progress to a file to back it up or move it to another device. Import restores your own progress from such a file. Stays on your device — no account, no network.

data.importInvalid: That file isn't a valid Lingvago progress backup. Your current progress is unchanged.
data.importError: Couldn't import that file. Your current progress is unchanged.

anki.title: Lesson words for Anki
anki.hint: Open the file in Anki (on a computer: double-click or File → Import; on a phone: Share → Anki). You get the deck “{{deck}}”: one card each way, with the tip shown alongside the answer. A newer file updates the words without resetting your reviews.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.intro: Write the number in words or in digits. Both cardinal and ordinal numbers come up.

conjugation.title: Conjugation
conjugation.intro: Write the present-tense verb form: for one person, or the whole table.

gender.title: Gender & articles
gender.intro: Choose or write the article: definite, indefinite, or contracted with a preposition (do, da, no, na, ao, à). When a word is given in brackets, write it in the gender the noun requires: (vários) ___ viagens → várias.

preposition.title: Prepositions
preposition.intro: Fill the blank with the right preposition: time, place or movement.

possessive.title: Possessives
possessive.intro: See whose thing it is and write the possessive in the right form: meu / minha, teu / tua, dele / dela.

interrogative.title: Question words
interrogative.intro: Use the hint to write the question word: quem, onde, como, quando, porquê.
